Innovation & Entrepreneurship

Breadcrumb

  1. Home

We ignite the entrepreneurial spirit and empower future leaders to build a better tomorrow.

Facts & Figures Knowledge Transfer Events Success Stories Startups Entrepreneurship News Industry Collaboration Mainland Incubator Entrepreneurship Education

Inspiring Tomorrow’s Technopreneurs

We believe that positive change depends on the efforts of ambitious non-conformists eager to challenge the status quo.

Leveraging our location in the Greater Bay Area, the HKUST Entrepreneurship Bootcamp and the HKUST InnoBay Bootcamp provide hands-on experience researching and implementing technology-based innovations to implement tech solutions for challenges.

We are also the home to the HKUST Founders’ Club, a vibrant community of successful and aspiring entrepreneurs, fostering connections and collaboration through our network of industry experts, investors and top talent.

Knowledge Transfer

The Office of Knowledge Transfer (OKT) serves as a bridge between the HKUST research community and industry, identifying commercial opportunities for research, collaboration, funding and start-ups. The HKUST Entrepreneurship Center (EC) nurtures entrepreneurial spirit by turning ideas from HKUST students to real businesses through incubation and competitions. The HKUST R and D Corporation Ltd. (RDC), a wholly owned subsidiary of the University, serves as HKUST’s business arm to manage contract research and service projects, license agreement, entrepreneurship program, shareholding of HKUST start‐up companies, and provide accounting, HR and procurement services.

Industry Collaboration

HKUST collaborates with industry leaders to access cutting-edge research, talents and solve complex challenges.

HKUST-Bright Dream Robotic Joint Research Institute (HBJRI)

HBJRI provides a unique platform to facilitate and strengthen the collaboration between University and Industry in talent development and technology innovation, with a focus on the mutually interested strategic areas.

Explore More

HKUST-Kaisa Joint Research Institute (HKJRI)

HKJRI was established to develop technology and knowledge to be commercialized for practical applications and products via platforms of Kaisa Holdings Limited.

Explore More

HKUST-Collaborative Innovation Center (HCIC)

HCIC aims to promote the various types of cooperation between HKUST and Beijing Institute of Collaborative Innovation (BICI) in projects beneficial to both Parties and society.
